name: Verificación de Datos IPTC
description: Verifica campos de metadatos IPTC para marcadores de autenticidad y clasificación de tipo de fuente digital.
mechanism:
The IPTC verification examines professional metadata layers:

1. **DigitalSourceType Classification**: Checks ISO 12639 DigitalSourceType field for non-photographic indicators such as 'trainedAlgorithmicMedia', 'algorithmicMedia', 'virtualRecording', or 'compositeSynthetic'.

2. **Authenticity Field Count**: Counts professional IPTC fields (credit, source, copyright, writer, caption, byline, city, country, headline, keywords). High field count indicates professional photographic workflow.

3. **AI Reference Detection**: Scans IPTC values for references to AI tools (Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, Midjourney, etc.) in source, credit, and software fields.

4. **Workflow Validation**: Validates that IPTC metadata follows professional photography conventions — wire services, stock agencies, and newsrooms embed rich IPTC data.
parameters:
IPTC authenticity fields: credit, source, copyright, writer, caption, byline, city, country, headline, keywords, instructions, category
DigitalSourceType values: photographicImage, negativeFilm, positiveFilm, trainedAlgorithmicMedia, algorithmicMedia, virtualRecording
ISO 12639 classifications
accuracy: High - 85%+ for professional news/stock photos with IPTC data. Limited for consumer photos which rarely include IPTC.
useCase: Professional photo verification: validates images from news agencies, stock photo services, and professional photographers. The presence of comprehensive IPTC metadata strongly indicates professional origin.
strengths:
• DigitalSourceType proporciona declaración explícita de AI
• Fotos profesionales tienen datos IPTC ricos
• Estándar de la industria en todas las agencias de noticias
• Identifica herramientas AI específicas
• Cero falsos positivos con DigitalSourceType
limitations:
• Fotos de consumo raramente contienen IPTC
• Los campos IPTC pueden ser fabricados
• Muchos servicios AI no establecen DigitalSourceType
• Las redes sociales eliminan IPTC
• La ausencia de IPTC no indica generación AI
